title: Radiomics Improves Cancer Screening and Early Detection

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Imaging is a key technology in the early detection of cancers, including X-ray mammography, low-dose CT for lung cancer, or optical imaging for skin, esophageal, or colorectal cancers.
